Bathroom decorations do far more than fill empty space — the right choices around your bathtub can turn an ordinary room into a genuinely calming retreat. Whether you are working with a compact alcove tub or a statement freestanding piece, the way you style the surrounding area shapes the entire feel of the room. In this guide, we walk through every layer of bathtub styling, from wall art and lighting to plants and storage, so you can make confident choices that suit your home.

By Mae Osz | Interior Design Consultant & Home Decor Expert with 12+ years of experience.

How to decorate a bathtub? A bathtub is often the focal point of a bathroom, serving both functional and aesthetic purposes. Enhancing the bathtub area can significantly boost relaxation and elevate the overall look of your bathroom. Here, we'll explore essential tips for transforming your bathtub into a stylish and inviting space.

Quick Answer: The most effective way to decorate around a bathtub is to layer complementary elements — moisture-resistant wall art, adjustable lighting, coordinating textiles, and a few natural touches such as plants or candles. Choose a consistent colour palette first, then build outwards with functional accessories that also look beautiful. Even small changes like a stylish bathtub tray or a framed print can dramatically lift the feel of the space.

The Importance of a Well-Decorated Bathtub 

  • Choosing the Right Bathtub: Style and Functionality

Different Types of Bathtubs

-Freestanding Tubs: Versatile and elegant, ideal for spacious bathrooms.

- Alcove Tubs: Perfect for smaller spaces, offering a streamlined look.

- Clawfoot Tubs: Vintage charm with a touch of luxury. 

Selecting a Bathtub that Fits Your Space and Design Preferences

Consider the size, shape, and material of the bathtub to ensure it complements your bathroom's layout and decor. 

How to decorate a bathtub: Colour Palettes for Setting the Mood

Choosing Colours that Complement Your Overall Bathroom Decor

Select colours that blend seamlessly with your bathroom's existing design. 

Using Neutral Tones for a Spa-Like Feel or Bold Colours for a Statement

- Neutral Tones: Create a calming and spa-like atmosphere.

- Bold Colours: Make a striking statement and add personality to the space. 

  • Surrounding Wall Decor: Enhancing the Ambiance

Using Tiles, Beadboard, or Paint for the Bathtub Surround

- Tile: Durable and water-resistant, available in various patterns and colours.

- Beadboard: Adds a classic, cottage-like charm.

- Pain: Versatile and easy to update. 

Incorporating Accent Walls with Bold Patterns or Colours

An accent wall can add visual interest and make the bathtub area stand out. 

  • Wall Art Prints: Adding Personality and Style

Selecting Waterproof or Moisture-Resistant Art Prints

Choose art prints that can withstand the humid bathroom environment. 

Choosing Themes that Reflect Your Personal Style

- Nature: Brings a serene and calming vibe.

- Abstract: Adds modern and dynamic flair.

- Minimalist: Keeps the space clean and uncluttered. 

Arranging Wall Art Prints Strategically Around the Bathtub Area

Place art prints where they can be easily seen and enjoyed without being directly exposed to water. 

Selecting waterproof or moisture-resistant art prints is essential for any bathroom setting — choose prints that can withstand the humid environment, and if you need further guidance on sizing and placement, our dedicated guide to bathroom wall art ideas covers everything you need to know.

  • Lighting: Creating the Right Atmosphere to decorate your bathtub

Installing Overhead Lighting, Wall Sconces, or Chandeliers

-Overhead Lighting: Provides general illumination.

-Wall Sconces: Adds focused light and elegance.

- Chandeliers: Makes a bold, luxurious statement. 

Using Dimmer Switches for Adjustable Lighting Levels

Adjustable lighting allows you to create the perfect ambience for relaxation.

Incorporating Candlelight for a Relaxing and Romantic Ambiance

Candles can enhance the mood, making bath time a more relaxing and indulgent experience. 

  • Functional Accessories: Combining Utility and Aesthetics

Choosing Bathtub Trays for Holding Books, Candles, or Drinks

A stylish bathtub tray adds both function and charm to your bath experience.

Using Attractive Soap Dispensers, Bath Salts Containers, and Towels

Opt for accessories that match your decor style and keep essentials within reach.

  • Greenery and Natural Elements: Bringing the Outdoors In

Adding Potted Plants or Hanging Planters Around the Bathtub

Introduce greenery to enhance the bathroom's freshness and tranquillity. 

Choosing Moisture-Loving Plants Like Ferns and Orchids

Select plants that thrive in the bathroom's humid environment. 

  • Textiles: Enhancing Comfort and Style

Selecting Plush Towels and Bathmats for Added Comfort

Choose high-quality, soft towels and bathmats for a luxurious feel. 

Using Coordinating Shower Curtains or Blinds

Ensure that shower curtains or blinds complement the overall colour scheme and design. 

  • Storage Solutions: Keeping the Area Clutter-Free

Installing Shelves, Niches, or Baskets for Bath Essentials

Use creative storage solutions to keep the bathtub area tidy and organised. 

Using Stylish Containers to Organise and Store Items

Select attractive containers that fit your decor style while keeping items accessible. 

Installing shelves, niches, or baskets for bath essentials is one of the most effective ways to keep the bathtub area tidy and organised — for more inspiration on making every inch work harder, see our guide to small restroom decor ideas.

  • Final Touches: Personalising Your Bathtub Area

Adding Decorative Items like Sculptures, Trinkets, or Framed Photos

Incorporate personal touches to make the space uniquely yours. 

Using Scented Candles or Diffusers for a Spa-Like Experience

Aromatic elements can enhance the relaxation and ambience of your bath.

Creating a Luxurious and Functional Bathtub Space

By following these essential tips, you can transform your bathtub area into a stylish and inviting space that enhances both relaxation and functionality. Experiment with different ideas and personalise your decor to create a truly unique and enjoyable bathroom oasis.

For the wall space between the tub and the rest of the room — including the often-neglected cistern wall — our dedicated guide to above toilet decor shows exactly how to turn that awkward spot into a considered focal point.  

Bathtub decoration ideas by style

The most successful bathroom transformations start with a clear style direction. A Japandi approach pairs neutral linen textiles with simple ceramic accessories and a single piece of understated wall art, keeping the space serene and uncluttered. A Coastal scheme suits soft blues and sandy neutrals, natural driftwood accessories, and botanical or seascape prints. For a Glam Luxe feel, metallic fixtures, deep jewel-toned towels, and a dramatic chandelier above a freestanding tub make an instant statement. Whichever direction you choose, consistency across colour, material, and texture is what makes the final result feel intentional rather than assembled.

If you are still searching for your signature look, these creative bathroom wall art ideas are a brilliant starting point for finding a style that suits your space.

Frequently Asked Questions About Bathroom Decorations

What type of wall art is safe to use near a bathtub? — Choose prints in sealed frames or canvases with moisture-resistant finishes. Keep art at least 60 cm from the tub edge and ensure the room is well ventilated to prevent condensation damage.

How do I make a small bathroom feel more luxurious with decorations? — Layer soft lighting with a statement mirror, add a single large botanical print rather than several small ones, and use matching metallic accessories to create a cohesive, high-end feel without cluttering the space.

Which plants work best as bathroom decorations near a bathtub? — Ferns, orchids, pothos, and peace lilies all thrive in the humidity near a bathtub. Position them on a floating shelf or a stool beside the tub where they receive indirect light.

Can I use candles as bathroom decorations safely? — Yes, but always place them on a stable, heat-resistant surface away from curtains and towels. Flameless LED candles are a practical alternative that still create the same warm, atmospheric glow.
